## Incident Report

**INCIDENT SUMMARY**

DESKTOP-L8C5GSJ (10.1.17.215) was infected with DynGate malware, a remote access trojan that masquerades as TeamViewer. The infection became active on 2025-01-22 at 23:45:58 UTC+4, initiating C2 beaconing to 5.252.153.241 and 45.125.66.32. The malware established persistent command-and-control connections across multiple channels, downloaded additional payloads including fake TeamViewer binaries, and executed PowerShell commands for lateral movement and persistence.

**VICTIM IDENTIFICATION**

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| IPv4 Address | 10.1.17.215 |
| MAC Address | 00:d0:b7:26:4a:74 |
| Hostname | DESKTOP-L8C5GSJ |
| Logged-in User | shutchenson |
| OS | Windows (Enterprise workstation) |

**MALWARE FAMILY**

DynGate (malware family signature confirmed via DNS query to ping3.dyngate.com and HTTP C2 traffic pattern matching behavioral signatures for DynGate RAT/stealer). Attribution confidence: **signature-confirmed** (DynGate domain in DNS, fake TeamViewer masquerade pattern, /1517096937 beaconing endpoint).

**COMMAND AND CONTROL INFRASTRUCTURE**

| Endpoint | Port | Protocol | Evidence |
|----------|------|----------|----------|
| 5.252.153.241 | 80 | HTTP | Direct C2 beaconing to /1517096937, download commands from /api/file/get-file/ endpoints |
| 45.125.66.32 | 2917 | TCP (encrypted) | 3366 frames of C2 traffic, TLS handshake to bare IP (no SNI) |
| 45.125.66.252 | 2917 | TCP (encrypted) | Secondary encrypted C2 channel |
| 185.188.32.26 | 443 | HTTPS | Spoofed TeamViewer master server (master16.teamviewer.com) |
| ping3.dyngate.com | 53 | DNS | DynGate C2 domain in DNS queries |

**MALWARE ARTIFACTS**

| File Name | SHA256 | Evidence | Source |
|-----------|--------|----------|--------|
| TeamViewer | 904280f20d697d876ab90a1b74c0f22a83b859e8b0519cb411fda26f1642f53e | Downloaded 23:47:01 from 5.252.153.241/api/file/get-file/TeamViewer | DynGate payload |
| Teamviewer_Resource_fr | 9634ecaf469149379bba80a745f53d823948c41ce4e347860701cbdff6935192 | Downloaded 23:47:04 from 5.252.153.241/api/file/get-file/Teamviewer_Resource_fr | DynGate resource file |

**MALICIOUS URLS**

- http://5.252.153.241/1517096937 (C2 checkin endpoint, beaconing every ~5 seconds)
- http://5.252.153.241/1517096937?k=message%20=%20startup%20shortcut%20created;%20%20status%20=%20success; (status callback)
- http://5.252.153.241/1517096937?k=script:%20RunRH,%20status:%20OK,%20message:%20PS%20process%20started (PowerShell execution confirmation)
- http://5.252.153.241/api/file/get-file/TeamViewer (malware payload download)
- http://5.252.153.241/api/file/get-file/Teamviewer_Resource_fr (resource download)

**INFECTION TIMELINE**

- **23:44:56** - Capture begins; malware already resident on victim host
- **23:45:58** - First C2 beacon to 5.252.153.241/1517096937 (infection confirmation)
- **23:46:* to 23:47:01** - Repeated C2 beaconing (command polling), approximately every 5 seconds
- **23:47:01** - Download DynGate malware payload (TeamViewer) from C2
- **23:47:04** - Download resource file (Teamviewer_Resource_fr) from C2
- **23:47:05** - Malware executes startup shortcut creation; establishes persistence
- **23:47:* onward** - Continues C2 beaconing and executing PowerShell commands (indicated by "PS process started" status message)

**DELIVERY METHOD**

The initial infection vector is not fully captured (malware was active before capture start), but the attack chain shows:
1. Initial compromise of DESKTOP-L8C5GSJ
2. First callback to C2 at 5.252.153.241
3. C2 delivers DynGate malware payloads
4. Malware establishes persistence (startup shortcut)
5. PowerShell-based commands executed for lateral movement

**BENIGN CONTEXT** (OS telemetry and legitimate services, not indicators)
- Windows Update traffic (download.windowsupdate.com, au.download.windowsupdate.com, ctldl.windowsupdate.com)
- Microsoft services (api.msn.com, browser.events.data.microsoft.com, login.live.com, etc.)
- NTP pools (time.windows.com, pool.ntp.org)
- DNS SRV queries to internal AD domain (LDAP, Kerberos to BLUEMOONTUESDAY domain, 10.1.17.2 DC)
